title: CAP-2026 Capital projects 2026-27
summary: Cost centre CAP-2026 covers Capital projects 2026-27 under owner GWHITAKER, with £43,090.33 available budget in 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre CAP-2026 covers Capital projects 2026-27 at Northbridge Cycles [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026, the cost centre is active and open for capital expenditures under unit NBC-MAN-01 [^r1]. Its operating budget for the fourth quarter of 2026 retains £43,090.33 in available funds [^r2].

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Cost Centre | CAP-2026 |
| Name | Capital projects 2026-27 |
| Business Unit | NBC-MAN-01 |
| Owner | GWHITAKER |
| Status | OPEN |

## Budget and spending

Budget figures are recorded in the [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] workbook [^r1][^r2]. For 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, CAP-2026 has an allocated budget of £52,000 [^r2]. Committed spend against this budget stands at £8,909.67, leaving an available balance of £43,090.33 [^r2].
